entries.title: Psalms 118:1
segments: ¶O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: because his mercy [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:2
segments: Let Israel now say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:3
segments: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:4
segments: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:5
segments: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, [and set me] in a large place. {in distress: Heb. out of distress}

words.text: me, [and set me] in a large place

entries.title: Psalms 118:6
segments: The LORD [is] on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me? {on...: Heb. for me}

words.text: [is] on my side; I will not fear

entries.title: Psalms 118:7
segments: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see [my desire] upon them that hate me.

words.text: taketh my part with them that help

entries.title: Psalms 118:8
segments: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

entries.title: Psalms 118:9
segments: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:10
segments: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them. {destroy...: Heb. cut them off}

entries.title: Psalms 118:11
segments: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:12
segments: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them. {destroy: Heb. cut down}

entries.title: Psalms 118:13
segments: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

words.text: at me that I might fall

entries.title: Psalms 118:14
segments: The LORD [is] my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:15
segments: The voice of rejoicing and salvation [is] in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

entries.title: Psalms 118:16
segments: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

entries.title: Psalms 118:17
segments: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:18
segments: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

words.text: : but he hath not given me over

entries.title: Psalms 118:19
segments: ¶Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, [and] I will praise the LORD:

entries.title: Psalms 118:20
segments: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

entries.title: Psalms 118:21
segments: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

words.text: me, and art become my salvation

entries.title: Psalms 118:22
segments: The stone [which] the builders refused is become the head [stone] of the corner.

entries.title: Psalms 118:23
segments: This is the LORD'S doing; it [is] marvellous in our eyes. {the LORD's...: Heb. from the LORD}

entries.title: Psalms 118:24
segments: This [is] the day [which] the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:25
segments: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

entries.title: Psalms 118:26
segments: Blessed [be] he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:27
segments: God [is] the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, [even] unto the horns of the altar.

entries.title: Psalms 118:28
segments: Thou [art] my God, and I will praise thee: [thou art] my God, I will exalt thee.

entries.title: Psalms 118:29
segments: O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.
